name: VSN Fiat G.91Y Yankee
summary: VSN team's free Fiat/Aeritalia G.91Y light attack jet with selectable SFM or EFM.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the Fiat G.91Y with FC3/A-10A avionics; .cmd files switch between SFM and EFM flight models. Original 3D model by Enrico Gennari. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
